今天的主题：家庭、家务和性别平等。这组词在口语 Part 1 的 Home、Family 和 Part 3 的社会话题、写作 Task 2 的「男女分工」「家庭责任」类题目里都很常见。

例句

  • In many families, domestic work is still seen as a woman's responsibility.（在很多家庭里，家务仍然被看作是女人的责任。）
  • A recent survey shows that attitudes towards gender equality are changing among young people.（最近一项调查显示，年轻人对性别平等的看法正在改变。）
  • When both partners contribute to the household chores, neither of them feels the burden too much.（夫妻双方都分担家务时，谁都不会觉得负担太重。）
  • Flexible working hours allow parents to share the workload at home more fairly.（弹性工作时间让父母能更公平地分担家里的活。）

过关标准：遮住中文看英文，能说出 22 个以上的意思，再挑 5 个自己造句（试试用 responsibility、contribute、fairly 说说你家的家务是怎么分的）。

BBC 6 Minute English：Who does the housework?（谁来做家务？）。这集讲全世界女性每天比男性多干三小时无偿家务，以及印尼和克罗地亚两个帮夫妻公平分家务的项目。整体是生活话题，比上周的空调和语言学习那两集好懂，两段采访带口音，是难点。音频和原文都已经放在页面里，不用打开 BBC 网站。

  1. 先把上面的听前生词过一遍，听不太懂可以先读懂原文再听。
  2. 第一遍不看文字，只听大意，回答开头的问题：英国人最讨厌的家务是哪个？a) deep cleaning the oven（深度清洁烤箱） b) scrubbing the toilet（刷马桶） c) cleaning the windows（擦窗户）。顺便听出一个数字：女性每天比男性多花几个小时做无偿家务？
  3. 第二遍点开下面的原文精听，听不出的地方暂停、倒回去并标出来。Mama Shilpa 和 Anamarija 两段采访有口音，多听几遍，雅思听力里也常有非英国口音。
  4. 第三遍挑 Pippa 介绍 UN Women 数据那段（"Of course, no one enjoys cleaning the toilet..."）跟读，模仿语调和连读。
  5. 记住 6 个表达：chores（家务活）、fair share（应分担的那份）、women's work（女人的活，贬义）、division of labour（劳动分工）、take a breather（歇口气）、pull your weight（尽到自己那份力）。
点开看原文（难词带中文，点虚线词显示）
💡 点击或悬停虚线词看中文；点击说话人名字可单独切换该段翻译

Neil：Hello, this is 6 Minute English from BBC Learning English. I'm Neil.

Neil：大家好，这里是 BBC 学习英语的《六分钟英语》。我是尼尔。

Pippa：And I'm Pippa. When it comes to household家庭的，家务的 chores家务活, jobs like cleaning, washing clothes or looking after the kids, it's often women who do most of the work. Here, two female listeners of BBC World Service programme People Fixing the World share their experiences. Do they sound familiar to you?

Pippa：我是皮帕。说到家务，比如打扫、洗衣服、照看孩子，往往是女性干了大部分。下面两位 BBC 国际频道节目《改变世界的人》的女听众来分享她们的经历。你听着是不是很熟悉？

Listener 1：I do everything. I do all the house chores家务活, I do the food shopping, I do all the cooking, I clean the bathroom.

Listener 1：什么都是我做。所有家务都是我干，买菜是我，做饭全是我，打扫卫生间也是我。

Listener 2：Are the chores家务活 done equally between me and my husband? No, they're not done equally. I do most of the chores家务活.

Listener 2：我和我丈夫的家务分得平均吗？不，不平均。大部分家务是我做的。

Pippa：So, you're a family man顾家的男人, Neil. Do you do your fair share应分担的那份 of household家庭的，家务的 chores家务活?

Pippa：尼尔，你是个顾家的男人。家务你分担了自己该做的那份吗？

Neil：I think so. My wife works part time and I work full time, so when I'm not working, I do things, and when she's not working, she does things.

Neil：我觉得有。我妻子做兼职，我是全职，所以我不上班的时候我做，她不上班的时候她做。

Pippa：Yeah, it's similar in my house, so me and my husband try to split分摊，分开 things, but it's difficult, isn't it?

Pippa：嗯，我家也差不多，我和我丈夫尽量分摊，但挺难的，对吧？

Neil：It is.

Neil：是啊。

Pippa：Of course, no one enjoys cleaning the toilet or taking out the bins垃圾桶, but there is a serious side to the issue. Figures from UN Women, an organisation promoting gender equality平等, suggest that every day women around the world spend three hours more than men on unpaid无报酬的 care and domestic家庭的，家务的 work. So, in this episode, we'll be hearing about two projects helping husbands and wives share the housework more fairly.

Pippa：当然，没人喜欢刷马桶或倒垃圾，但这个问题也有严肃的一面。推动性别平等的组织「联合国妇女署」的数据显示，全世界的女性每天花在无偿照护和家务上的时间比男性多三个小时。所以这一集我们会介绍两个项目，它们在帮助夫妻更公平地分担家务。

Neil：And as usual, you'll find a quiz and a worksheet练习题 to go with this episode on our website, bbclearningenglish.com. But now I have a question for you, Pippa. According to a survey调查 conducted by Good Housekeeping magazine earlier this year, what is the most hated household家庭的，家务的 chore家务活 in Britain? Is it:
a) deep cleaning the oven烤箱,
b) scrubbing用力擦洗 the toilet, or
c) cleaning the windows?

Neil：和往常一样，我们网站 bbclearningenglish.com 上有这集配套的小测验和练习题。皮帕，现在我要问你一个问题。根据《好管家》杂志今年早些时候做的一项调查，英国人最讨厌的家务是什么？是：a) 深度清洁烤箱，b) 刷马桶，还是 c) 擦窗户？

Pippa：Hmm. I'm going to say deep cleaning the oven烤箱 because I really hate that job. I hardly ever do it.

Pippa：嗯，我选深度清洁烤箱，因为我真的很讨厌干这个，我几乎从来不做。

Neil：I don't like any of those, but we'll find out the answer at the end of the programme. Now, the first project we're going to look at is on the remote偏远的 Indonesian island of Rote. Here, men traditionally work as rice farmers or fishermen, while women look after the home, the children and older people. But with few washing machines and no running water自来水, these domestic家庭的，家务的 chores家务活 take a long time.

Neil：这几样我都不喜欢，答案节目最后揭晓。现在来看第一个项目，它在印度尼西亚偏远的罗特岛上。那里的男人传统上种稻或打鱼，女人则照顾家、孩子和老人。可是岛上洗衣机很少，也没有自来水，这些家务要花很长时间。

Pippa：The NGO非政府组织 ARUNGI runs a project trying to change attitudes态度，看法 about the role of the island's women. They work alongside community leaders like Mama Shilpa, who spoke with BBC World Service reporter Ade Mardiyati.

Pippa：非政府组织 ARUNGI 在那里开展了一个项目，想改变人们对岛上女性角色的看法。他们和 Mama Shilpa 这样的社区带头人一起合作，她接受了 BBC 国际频道记者 Ade Mardiyati 的采访。

Mama Shilpa：It is expected that the tasks done in the house, like holding the child, feeding the child, washing dishes, cooking, will all be done by the mother.

Mama Shilpa：大家默认家里的活，比如抱孩子、喂孩子、洗碗、做饭，都应该由母亲来做。

Ade Mardiyati：Shilpa tells me these are all considered women's work女人的活（贬义）. And you might be thinking, "Well, the man is busy in the fields, so it's just a fair division of labour劳动分工." But Shilpa tells me women also help out帮忙 in the fields.

Ade Mardiyati：Shilpa 告诉我，这些都被看作是「女人的活」。你可能会想：「男人在地里忙，这样分工挺公平的。」但 Shilpa 说，女人也要去地里帮忙。

Neil：On Rote, cleaning, cooking and sweeping扫地 are considered women's work女人的活（贬义）, a negative term for boring and repetitive重复的，单调的 tasks which are traditionally done by women.

Neil：在罗特岛，打扫、做饭和扫地被看作「女人的活」，这是个带贬义的说法，指那些传统上由女性来做的枯燥、重复的活。

Pippa：Many cultures have a division of labour劳动分工, a way of organising work where different tasks are done by different groups of people. But on Rote this means women work even harder, helping out with the farming and fishing too.

Pippa：很多文化里都有「劳动分工」，也就是把不同的活交给不同的人群来做的一种组织方式。但在罗特岛，这意味着女性干得更辛苦，还得帮着种地和打鱼。

Neil：You might think this only happens in traditional societies, but research suggests that women in wealthy富裕的 countries also spend much more time on unpaid无报酬的 care work than men. One such country is Croatia, where the NGO非政府组织 Status M run their Superdads project. Project worker Anamarija Sočo leads workshops工作坊，研讨会 encouraging dads and sons to take some of the pressure off减轻一些压力 mums. Here, she explains the benefits of this to the BBC World Service.

Neil：你可能以为这只发生在传统社会里，但研究表明，富裕国家的女性花在无偿照护上的时间也比男性多得多。克罗地亚就是这样一个国家，非政府组织 Status M 在那里开展「超级爸爸」项目。项目工作人员 Anamarija Sočo 带领工作坊，鼓励爸爸和儿子帮妈妈减轻一些压力。下面她向 BBC 国际频道解释这样做的好处。

Anamarija Sočo：Mothers have, you know, of course, more space for their careers, or hobbies, or just simply to rest, I mean, just to take a breather喘口气，歇一会儿. Women tend to especially appreciate欣赏，感激 men who do these kinds of chores家务活. And when they start pulling their weight尽到自己那份力, then they jokingly say that, "Uh yeah, women tend to nag唠叨 less."

Anamarija Sočo：妈妈们当然就有了更多空间去发展事业、培养爱好，或者干脆休息一下，就是喘口气。女性往往特别欣赏愿意做这些家务的男人。等男人开始尽到自己那份力，他们会开玩笑说：「嗯，老婆唠叨少了。」

Pippa：Sometimes mums need to take a breather喘口气，歇一会儿, an informal way of saying stop and rest a while.

Pippa：有时候妈妈们需要 take a breather，这是「停下来歇一会儿」的口语说法。

Neil：Anamarija also thinks women appreciate欣赏，感激 it when their husbands pull their weight尽到自己那份力. If you pull your weight尽到自己那份力, you work as hard as everyone else.

Neil：Anamarija 还认为，丈夫尽到自己那份力时，妻子会很感激。pull your weight 就是你和其他人一样卖力干活。

Pippa：Both these NGO非政府组织 projects agree about one thing, men doing more to help around the house results in happier homes, even if that means cleaning the toilet now and then时不时. And speaking of cleaning the toilet, what was the answer to your quiz question, Neil?

Pippa：这两个非政府组织的项目在一点上看法一致：男人多帮忙做家务，家庭就更幸福，哪怕这意味着时不时要刷刷马桶。说到刷马桶，尼尔，你那道小测验的答案是什么？

Neil：I asked you what chore家务活 is the most hated in Britain.

Neil：我问你英国人最讨厌的家务是什么。

Pippa：I thought it was cleaning the oven烤箱.

Pippa：我以为是清洁烤箱。

Neil：Well, I'm afraid that's not the right answer. People hate cleaning the windows even more than scrubbing用力擦洗 the oven烤箱. Apparently, 23% of the people who did the survey调查 said cleaning the windows. OK. Let's recap回顾 the vocabulary we've learned, starting with chores家务活, household家庭的，家务的 tasks like cleaning, washing and ironing熨衣服 that have to be done regularly.

Neil：恐怕答错了。人们讨厌擦窗户甚至超过刷烤箱。据说参加调查的人里有 23% 选了擦窗户。好，我们来回顾一下今天学的词，先是 chores，指打扫、洗衣、熨衣服这类必须经常做的家务。

Pippa：If you do your fair share应分担的那份 of work, you do a reasonable amount.

Pippa：do your fair share 指你干了合理的、该干的那一份。

Neil：Women's work女人的活（贬义） is a negative term for the boring and repetitive重复的，单调的 tasks which are stereotypically按刻板印象地 done by women.

Neil：women's work（女人的活）是个贬义说法，指那些按刻板印象由女性来做的枯燥、重复的活。

Pippa：The division of labour劳动分工 is a way of organising work where different tasks are done by different groups of people.

Pippa：division of labour（劳动分工）是一种组织工作的方式，不同的任务由不同的人群来做。

Neil：The idiom take a breather喘口气，歇一会儿 means to stop what you're doing for a short time and rest.

Neil：习语 take a breather 的意思是暂时停下手头的事歇一会儿。

Pippa：And finally, if you pull your weight尽到自己那份力, you work as hard as everyone else doing the same job. Once again, our six minutes are up, but remember, you can find a free transcript including all the vocabulary on our website, at bbclearningenglish.com. Goodbye for now.

Pippa：最后，pull your weight 指你和做同样工作的其他人一样卖力。我们的六分钟又到了，记住，在我们网站 bbclearningenglish.com 上可以找到免费的原文，里面有所有词汇。下次见。

Neil：Goodbye!

Neil：再见！

过关标准：不看原文能用中文说出这集讲了什么（女性多干多少家务，两个项目分别在哪、做了什么，男人多分担家务有什么好处），6 个表达都知道意思，Pippa 那段能流利读下来。

小练习

  1. Washing the dishes is one of the ______ I hate most.（家务活）
  2. Everyone in the team should do their ______ ______ of the work.（应分担的那份）
  3. In the past, a strict ______ ______ ______ meant men worked outside and women stayed at home.（劳动分工）
  4. We've been working for three hours. Let's ______ ______ ______.（歇一会儿）
  5. If you don't ______ ______ ______, your colleagues will be annoyed.（尽到自己那份力）
  6. Women spend more time on ______ care work than men.（无偿的）
点开看答案

开头那题选 c，23% 的受访者说最讨厌擦窗户，Pippa 猜的烤箱错了。数字题：3 个小时。填空：1. chores 2. fair share 3. division of labour 4. take a breather 5. pull your weight 6. unpaid
